title: One Square Holds
setup: White's king has just come up behind its pawn on the sixth, and Black has three squares to pick from.
hint: Two of your three squares let the white king step around to d7 or f7. One of them does not.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Ke8}} is the only move. Answer {{Kd6}} with {{Kd8}}, and {{e7+}} then drives the king back in front of the pawn, where White has nothing left but stalemate. Go to d8 or f8 instead and White takes the opposition and queens.
